oneLine: Goldman Sachs sells shares in Eternal via a block deal.

sources.title: Goldman Sachs Sells Eternal Shares Via A ₹169 Cr Block Deal

synopsis: Goldman Sachs, via its entity Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE, has sold 53.4 lakh shares of foodtech giant Eternal in a block deal worth ₹168.7 Cr. The shares were sold at ₹316 apiece, representing a discount of more than 2.6% to the stock's previous closing price. The buyer was Bank of America through its affiliate BofA Securities Europe. The transaction allows the investment bank to book profits following a sharp uptick in Eternal's share price and improving financials driven by its quick commerce arm, Blinkit.
